title: agentgw decision input
description: Everything a policy engine may look at to decide one tool call. Language-agnostic: the Cedar backend and any future backend consume exactly this. Version 1.

args.description: The raw MCP tools/call arguments object. {} when the call had none.

time.description: UTC RFC 3339. Policies compare grants and windows against this, never against wall clock.

estimated_cost.description: From the Pricer. Zero when the tool is unpriced.

budget_remaining.description: Remaining budget per window for this principal and tool, from Budget.Remaining. A window with no configured limit is absent.

grants.description: Active grants for this principal, from Approver.Grants. May be empty, never absent.
